prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Sign In & Keep Your Desktop Pet Safe", "body": "Log in with your existing account to restore your pet collection and save state automatically.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Account Sync Active", "style": "emphasis"}]}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_launch_guide", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_launch_guide": {"headline": "Desktop Pet Controls", "body": "Learn how to summon, interact, and manage your pet directly from your desktop system tray.", "button_label": "Got It, Launch Pet", "layout": "centered"}, "home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion is Ready!"}}

   config: {"story": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Welcome to Your Virtual Desktop Companion", "body": "Choose how you want to bring your desktop pet to life—select a premade companion or create a custom pet.", "components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:intro_anim", "style": "playful"}]}}

   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Pet Adoption & Naming", "body": "Give your desktop pet a custom name before bringing them onto your desktop.", "components": [{"type": "name_input", "text": "Enter Pet Name", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "badge", "label": "Official Adoption Certificate", "style": "highlight"}]}}

   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "Tip: Make sure your system tray allows background apps so your pet can roam freely on screen.", "show_progress": true, "notify_when_ready": true}}
5: [finish, copy] Right-Click Control Copy on Home Intro: Update the home intro headline and body to explicitly mention right-clicking the system tray icon to control pets.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop", "body": "Right-click the tray icon anytime to chat, hide, or adjust pet settings.", "button_label": "Start Playing"}}

   config: {"pick_friend": {"headline": "Choose Your Ready-to-Adopt Companion", "body": "Select a pet persona below to immediately generate your desktop friend.", "hint": "You can change pet skins and personalities later in desktop settings."}}
7: [choose_path, copy] Path Differentiation Copy on Choose Path: Clarify the difference between custom pet creation and quick pet picking on the choose path screen.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "How Would You Like to Start?", "body": "Pick an existing pet design for quick setup, or upload your own photos to create a custom pet.", "button_label": "Continue"}}
8: [sign_in, hint] Same-Email Device Sync Hint on Sign-In: Add an explicit hint to sign in with the exact same credentials used previously to prevent pet loss.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Be sure to sign in with the same email used on other devices to sync existing pets.", "button_label": "Sign In to Sync"}}
9: [home, wait_info] Generation Time & Progress Bar on Waiting Screen: Enable time estimates and explicit progress indicators on the waiting screen while desktop animations process.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Bringing Your Pet to Life...", "body": "Your companion is being rendered and configured for desktop animations. This takes under a minute.", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}

verdicts.reason: Redesign retains sign-in functionality and does not break any base rules.
Adding a new launch guide screen inside onboarding is permitted and preserves all required steps.
Redesigning the story screen layout while keeping pet introduction job is valid.
The adoption certificate redesign replaces the required official stamp with a generic badge, losing a core requirement of the adoption certificate screen.
Adding a system tray visibility hint to the waiting screen preserves pet creation status and breaks no rules.
Updating home intro text to explain desktop tray controls is allowed inside onboarding.
Updating copy on the pick friend screen retains its core job of letting users choose a pet.
Copy update clearly offers both adopting and creating options on choose path.
Adding a credential sync hint on the sign-in screen is permitted.
Displaying generation time estimates and progress indicators on the waiting screen is permitted.
